results.title: Free vs Paid Podcast Hosting - Why Would Anyone Ever Pay? | RSS.com Podcast Hosting
results.snippet: Only a few platforms offer truly unlimited free hosting with no deletion policies or storage caps. In November 2025, RSS.com launched a forever free plan specifically for local and niche podcasters.

results.title: RSS.com Pricing 2026
results.snippet: Paid plans start at $4.99/month for educational and non-profit plans. The most popular plan is $12.99/month or $8.25/month if paid annually. 30-days money back guarantee. RSS.com has 3 pricing editions, from $0 to $8.25.
